major_cooldowns.name: Adrenaline Rush
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown at 2 or fewer combo points, then keep spending finishers so Restless Blades pulls it back sooner.

major_cooldowns.name: Roll the Bones
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Reroll on cooldown whenever you are down to one buff or none, and keep any roll that lands two or more.

major_cooldowns.name: Blade Rush
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it on cooldown, but on a single target wait until your energy has room so its energy return is not wasted.

major_cooldowns.name: Between the Eyes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it at 6 or more combo points every time it comes up, and press your on-use trinkets inside its buff.

major_cooldowns.name: Killing Spree
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it as a finisher in the window right after Adrenaline Rush, and let Between the Eyes go first when both are ready.

major_cooldowns.name: Keep It Rolling
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Lock in a Roll the Bones of two or more buffs instead of saving it, since Restless Blades returns it in about a minute.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Tooltip cooldown is 360s; the guide states an effective in-combat cooldown near 1:15 thanks to Restless Blades, so 75s is used here.

major_cooldowns.name: Blade Flurry
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Turn it on before you build whenever a second target is in range, and recast it at 4 or fewer combo points once 4 or more targets are up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Three live ids share this name; 13877 is the one seen in casts and as the self aura in current parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Preparation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it once Between the Eyes, Adrenaline Rush, Killing Spree, and Blade Rush are all on cooldown, and aim that reset at a burn or add phase without holding long enough to lose a cast.

defensives.name: Cloak of Shadows
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to wipe a dangerous magic debuff or to walk through a heavy magic hit.

defensives.name: Evasion
defensives.usage_rule: Pop it for heavy melee or physical damage you cannot step out of.
defensives.id_note: Castable per its tooltip; no casts in the sampled parses.

defensives.name: Crimson Vial
defensives.usage_rule: Press it whenever you get chipped down, since the short cooldown lets you use it often.

defensives.name: Feint
defensives.usage_rule: Press it just before a raid-wide hit for the area damage reduction.

rules.description: Open with Adrenaline Rush, Roll the Bones, then Blade Rush
rules.action: Set up Adrenaline Rush and Roll the Bones first, then send Blade Rush and start building.

rules.description: Adrenaline Rush after you dump combo points
rules.action: Spend your combo points before you press Adrenaline Rush.

rules.description: Between the Eyes only on a full combo point bar
rules.action: Build your combo points up before you fire Between the Eyes.

rules.description: Dispatch only at high combo points
rules.action: Keep building instead of throwing Dispatch out early.

rules.description: Do not overcap combo points with Sinister Strike
rules.action: Finish before your combo points cap rather than pressing Sinister Strike again.

rules.description: Pistol Shot as your builder while Opportunity is up
rules.action: Spend Opportunity with Pistol Shot instead of pressing Sinister Strike again.
Reapply Slice and Dice the moment it falls off.

rules.description: Killing Spree right after Adrenaline Rush
rules.action: Send Killing Spree in the window right after Adrenaline Rush instead of banking it.

rules.description: Blade Flurry only with a second target in range
rules.action: Hold Blade Flurry until a second target is in range.

source_summary: Outlaw has no single burst window, so the plan is to keep Adrenaline Rush, Blade Rush, Between the Eyes, and Killing Spree moving on cooldown while spending combo points constantly so Restless Blades pulls them back. Roll the Bones is rerolled at one buff or fewer and locked in with Keep It Rolling once it lands two or more, and Preparation is saved for the moment your other cooldowns are all down, ideally on a burn or add phase. Blade Flurry joins the on cooldown list as soon as a second target is in range.
